SUPABASE PROJECT BACKUP
=======================

Project reference: osjikdsebniwnzancsjl
Backup timestamp (UTC): 20261122_072314_UTC
Project URL: https://osjikdsebniwnzancsjl.supabase.co

DATABASE
--------
- full_project.dump: custom-format full database archive jika tersedia.
- schema.sql: schema-only extract dari archive yang sama.
- data.sql: data-only extract dari archive yang sama bila BACKUP_DATABASE_DATA=True.
- inventory/: metadata schema, tabel, kolom, relasi, routine, trigger, policy, index, role, extension, dependency, dan TOC restore.
- roles.sql: custom roles tanpa password/hash.

EDGE FUNCTIONS
---------------
Source diunduh menggunakan Supabase CLI. Daftar secret hanya berisi nama/metadata, bukan nilai secret.

STORAGE
-------
- buckets.json: konfigurasi bucket.
- objects.jsonl: daftar metadata object.
- objects/: file fisik dari bucket.

PROJECT CONFIGURATION
---------------------
Metadata/config diambil melalui Management API jika token memiliki permission yang dibutuhkan.

KEAMANAN DAN BATASAN
--------------------
- PAT, Service Role Key, database password dan nilai secret tidak ditulis ke file/log.
- data.sql dan full_project.dump berisi data database, termasuk tabel Auth/Storage yang dapat dibaca role database. Simpan backup secara privat.
- Storage file fisik disimpan terpisah dari metadata database.
- Role password/hash tidak diekspor; LOGIN role perlu diberi password ulang saat restore.
- Global database roles dan konfigurasi platform tertentu tidak sepenuhnya dapat dipulihkan hanya dari dump database.
- Extension yang tercatat harus tersedia/diizinkan pada project tujuan.
- Beberapa API konfigurasi bersifat experimental atau memerlukan permission PAT terpisah.
- Ini adalah backup ekspor project, bukan pengganti backup/PITR fisik dari Supabase.

-- auth.email()
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION auth.email()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  select 
  coalesce(
    nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.email', true), ''),
    (nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'email')
  )::text
$function$


;

-- extensions.grant_pg_cron_access()
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION extensions.grant_pg_cron_access()
 RETURNS event_trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT
    FROM pg_event_trigger_ddl_commands() AS ev
    JOIN pg_extension AS ext
    ON ev.objid = ext.oid
    WHERE ext.extname = 'pg_cron'
  )
  THEN
    grant usage on schema cron to postgres with grant option;

    alter default privileges in schema cron grant all on tables to postgres with grant option;
    alter default privileges in schema cron grant all on functions to postgres with grant option;
    alter default privileges in schema cron grant all on sequences to postgres with grant option;

    alter default privileges for user supabase_admin in schema cron grant all
        on sequences to postgres with grant option;
    alter default privileges for user supabase_admin in schema cron grant all
        on tables to postgres with grant option;
    alter default privileges for user supabase_admin in schema cron grant all
        on functions to postgres with grant option;

    grant all privileges on all tables in schema cron to postgres with grant option;
    revoke all on table cron.job from postgres;
    grant select on table cron.job to postgres with grant option;
    revoke trigger on cron.job_run_details from postgres;
  END IF;
END;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- extensions.grant_pg_graphql_access()
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION extensions.grant_pg_graphql_access()
 RETURNS event_trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
    if not exists (
        select 1
        from pg_catalog.pg_event_trigger_ddl_commands() ev
        join pg_catalog.pg_extension e on ev.objid = e.oid
        where e.extname = 'pg_graphql'
    ) then
        return;
    end if;

    drop function if exists graphql_public.graphql;
    create or replace function graphql_public.graphql(
        "operationName" text default null,
        query text default null,
        variables jsonb default null,
        extensions jsonb default null
    )
        returns jsonb
        language sql
    as $$
        select graphql.resolve(
            query := query,
            variables := coalesce(variables, '{}'),
            "operationName" := "operationName",
            extensions := extensions
        );
    $$;

    -- Attach the wrapper to the extension so DROP EXTENSION cascades to it,
    -- which in turn triggers set_graphql_placeholder to reinstall the "not enabled" stub.
    alter extension pg_graphql add function graphql_public.graphql(text, text, jsonb, jsonb);

    grant usage on schema graphql to postgres, anon, authenticated, service_role;
    grant execute on function graphql.resolve to postgres, anon, authenticated, service_role;
    grant usage on schema graphql to postgres with grant option;
    grant usage on schema graphql_public to postgres with grant option;
end;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- extensions.grant_pg_net_access()
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION extensions.grant_pg_net_access()
 RETURNS event_trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM pg_event_trigger_ddl_commands() AS ev
    JOIN pg_extension AS ext
    ON ev.objid = ext.oid
    WHERE ext.extname = 'pg_net'
  )
  THEN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM pg_roles
      WHERE rolname = 'supabase_functions_admin'
    )
    THEN
      CREATE USER supabase_functions_admin NOINHERIT CREATEROLE LOGIN NOREPLICATION;
    END IF;

    GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA net TO supabase_functions_admin, postgres, anon, authenticated, service_role;

    IF EXISTS (
      SELECT FROM pg_extension
      WHERE extname = 'pg_net'
      -- all versions in use on existing projects as of 2025-02-20
      -- version 0.12.0 onwards don't need these applied
      AND extversion IN ('0.2', '0.6', '0.7', '0.7.1', '0.8.0', '0.10.0', '0.11.0')
    ) THEN
      ALTER function net.http_get(url text, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) SECURITY DEFINER;
      ALTER function net.http_post(url text, body jsonb, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) SECURITY DEFINER;

      ALTER function net.http_get(url text, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) SET search_path = net;
      ALTER function net.http_post(url text, body jsonb, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) SET search_path = net;

      REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION net.http_get(url text, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) FROM PUBLIC;
      REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION net.http_post(url text, body jsonb, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) FROM PUBLIC;

      GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION net.http_get(url text, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) TO supabase_functions_admin, postgres, anon, authenticated, service_role;
      GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION net.http_post(url text, body jsonb, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) TO supabase_functions_admin, postgres, anon, authenticated, service_role;
    END IF;
  END IF;
END;
$function$


;

-- extensions.pgrst_ddl_watch()
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION extensions.pgrst_ddl_watch()
 RETURNS event_trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  cmd record;
BEGIN
  FOR cmd IN SELECT * FROM pg_event_trigger_ddl_commands()
  LOOP
    IF cmd.command_tag IN (
      'CREATE SCHEMA', 'ALTER SCHEMA'
    , 'CREATE TABLE', 'CREATE TABLE AS', 'SELECT INTO', 'ALTER TABLE'
    , 'CREATE FOREIGN TABLE', 'ALTER FOREIGN TABLE'
    , 'CREATE VIEW', 'ALTER VIEW'
    , 'CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW', 'ALTER MATERIALIZED VIEW'
    , 'CREATE FUNCTION', 'ALTER FUNCTION'
    , 'CREATE TRIGGER'
    , 'CREATE TYPE', 'ALTER TYPE'
    , 'CREATE RULE'
    , 'COMMENT'
    )
    -- don't notify in case of CREATE TEMP table or other objects created on pg_temp
    AND cmd.schema_name is distinct from 'pg_temp'
    THEN
      NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';
    END IF;
  END LOOP;
END; $function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- extensions.pgrst_drop_watch()
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION extensions.pgrst_drop_watch()
 RETURNS event_trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  obj record;
BEGIN
  FOR obj IN SELECT * FROM pg_event_trigger_dropped_objects()
  LOOP
    IF obj.object_type IN (
      'schema'
    , 'table'
    , 'foreign table'
    , 'view'
    , 'materialized view'
    , 'function'
    , 'trigger'
    , 'type'
    , 'rule'
    )
    AND obj.is_temporary IS false -- no pg_temp objects
    THEN
      NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';
    END IF;
  END LOOP;
END; $function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- extensions.set_graphql_placeholder()
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION extensions.set_graphql_placeholder()
 RETURNS event_trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
    DECLARE
    graphql_is_dropped bool;
    BEGIN
    graphql_is_dropped = (
        SELECT ev.schema_name = 'graphql_public'
        FROM pg_event_trigger_dropped_objects() AS ev
        WHERE ev.schema_name = 'graphql_public'
    );

    IF graphql_is_dropped
    THEN
        create or replace function graphql_public.graphql(
            "operationName" text default null,
            query text default null,
            variables jsonb default null,
            extensions jsonb default null
        )
            returns jsonb
            language plpgsql
            set search_path to ''
        as $$
            DECLARE
                server_version float;
            BEGIN
                server_version = (SELECT (SPLIT_PART((select version()), ' ', 2))::float);

                IF server_version >= 14 THEN
                    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
                        'errors', jsonb_build_array(
                            jsonb_build_object(
                                'message', 'pg_graphql extension is not enabled.'
                            )
                        )
                    );
                ELSE
                    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
                        'errors', jsonb_build_array(
                            jsonb_build_object(
                                'message', 'pg_graphql is only available on projects running Postgres 14 onwards.'
                            )
                        )
                    );
                END IF;
            END;
        $$;
    END IF;

    END;
$function$


;

-- pgbouncer.get_auth(p_usename text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION pgbouncer.get_auth(p_usename text)
 RETURNS TABLE(username text, password text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  BEGIN
      RAISE DEBUG 'PgBouncer auth request: %', p_usename;

      RETURN QUERY
      SELECT
          rolname::text,
          CASE WHEN rolvaliduntil < now()
              THEN null
              ELSE rolpassword::text
          END
      FROM pg_authid
      WHERE rolname=$1 and rolcanlogin;
  END;
  $function$


;

-- public.activate_print_template(p_template_id uuid)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.activate_print_template(p_template_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if not public.is_portal_admin() then
    raise exception 'Akses admin diperlukan.';
  end if;
  if not exists (select 1 from public.print_templates where id = p_template_id) then
    raise exception 'Versi master tidak ditemukan.';
  end if;
  update public.print_templates set is_active = false where is_active = true;
  update public.print_templates set is_active = true where id = p_template_id;
  return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'active_template_id', p_template_id);
end;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.convert_applicant_to_employee(p_applicant_id uuid, p_employee_no text, p_department text, p_position text, p_employment_status text, p_join_date date, p_notes text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.convert_applicant_to_employee(p_applicant_id uuid, p_employee_no text, p_department text DEFAULT ''::text, p_position text DEFAULT ''::text, p_employment_status text DEFAULT 'Aktif'::text, p_join_date date DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE, p_notes text DEFAULT ''::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_employee_id uuid;
  v_stage text;
begin
  if not public.is_portal_admin() then
    raise exception 'Akses admin diperlukan.';
  end if;
  if nullif(trim(p_employee_no), '') is null then
    raise exception 'Nomor karyawan wajib diisi.';
  end if;
  if p_employment_status not in ('Aktif','Probation','Kontrak','Tetap','Nonaktif') then
    raise exception 'Status karyawan tidak valid.';
  end if;
  select stage into v_stage from public.applicants where id = p_applicant_id for update;
  if v_stage is null then raise exception 'Kandidat tidak ditemukan.'; end if;
  if v_stage not in ('disc_completed','stage4_pending') then
    raise exception 'Kandidat belum menyelesaikan tahap DISC.';
  end if;
  if exists(select 1 from public.employees where applicant_id = p_applicant_id) then
    raise exception 'Kandidat sudah tercatat sebagai karyawan.';
  end if;
  insert into public.employees(
    applicant_id, employee_no, department, position, employment_status, join_date, notes
  ) values (
    p_applicant_id, trim(p_employee_no), coalesce(trim(p_department), ''),
    coalesce(trim(p_position), ''), p_employment_status, p_join_date,
    coalesce(trim(p_notes), '')
  ) returning id into v_employee_id;
  update public.applicants set stage = 'hired', updated_at = now() where id = p_applicant_id;
  return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'employee_id', v_employee_id);
exception when unique_violation then
  raise exception 'Nomor karyawan sudah digunakan atau kandidat sudah dikonversi.';
end;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.delete_portal_user(p_username text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.delete_portal_user(p_username text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_target public.admin_login_credentials%rowtype;
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_portal_admin() OR NOT public.is_root_admin() THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Hanya akun Admin utama yang dapat menghapus user.';
  END IF;
  SELECT * INTO v_target
  FROM public.admin_login_credentials
  WHERE username = lower(btrim(coalesce(p_username, '')));
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'User tidak ditemukan.';
  END IF;
  IF lower(v_target.username) = 'admin' OR v_target.auth_user_id = auth.uid() THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Tidak dapat menghapus akun Admin utama atau akun yang sedang aktif digunakan.';
  END IF;
  DELETE FROM public.admin_login_credentials WHERE username = v_target.username;
  IF v_target.auth_user_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    DELETE FROM public.admin_users WHERE user_id = v_target.auth_user_id;
  END IF;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', true);
END;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.find_admin_auth_user(p_username text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.find_admin_auth_user(p_username text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth'
AS $function$
  select id
  from auth.users
  where lower(email) = lower(btrim(p_username) || '@portal.internal')
  order by created_at asc
  limit 1;
$function$


;

-- public.get_disc_candidate_by_nik(p_nik text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_disc_candidate_by_nik(p_nik text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_nik text := regexp_replace(coalesce(p_nik, ''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g');
  v_result jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF length(v_nik) <> 16 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'NIK harus terdiri dari 16 angka.';
  END IF;
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'full_name', a.full_name,
    'position', a.position,
    'stage', a.stage,
    'disc_completed', exists (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.disc_submissions d WHERE d.applicant_id = a.id
    )
  )
  INTO v_result
  FROM public.applicants a
  WHERE a.nik = v_nik
    AND a.stage IN ('application_submitted', 'disc_completed')
  ORDER BY a.created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1;
  RETURN v_result;
END;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.get_my_admin_profile()
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_admin_profile()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT COALESCE(
    (
      SELECT jsonb_build_object(
        'username', c.username,
        'employee_nik', coalesce(nullif(c.employee_nik, ''), upper(c.username)),
        'display_name', c.display_name,
        'role', c.role,
        'is_root_admin', (lower(c.username) = 'admin')
      )
      FROM public.admin_login_credentials c
      WHERE c.auth_user_id = auth.uid()
      LIMIT 1
    ),
    (
      SELECT jsonb_build_object(
        'username', CASE WHEN lower(u.display_name) = 'administrator' THEN 'admin' ELSE '' END,
        'employee_nik', CASE WHEN lower(u.display_name) = 'administrator' THEN 'ADMIN' ELSE '' END,
        'display_name', u.display_name,
        'role', u.role,
        'is_root_admin', (lower(u.display_name) = 'administrator')
      )
      FROM public.admin_users u
      WHERE u.user_id = auth.uid()
      LIMIT 1
    )
  );
$function$


;

-- public.is_root_admin()
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_root_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$

    FROM public.admin_login_credentials c

  );
$function$


;

-- public.list_applicants_lean()
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_applicants_lean()
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, full_name text, nik text, "position" text, stage text, application_data jsonb, cv_path text, ktp_path text, created_at timestamp with time zone, disc_submissions jsonb, employees jsonb)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_portal_admin() THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Akses admin diperlukan.';
  END IF;
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    a.id,
    a.full_name,
    a.nik,
    a."position",
    a.stage,
    coalesce(a.application_data, '{}'::jsonb) - 'ktp_foto',
    a.cv_path,
    a.ktp_path,
    a.created_at,
    coalesce((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', d.id, 'answers', d.answers, 'completed_at', d.completed_at))
      FROM public.disc_submissions d
      WHERE d.applicant_id = a.id
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    coalesce((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', e.id))
      FROM public.employees e
      WHERE e.applicant_id = a.id
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
  FROM public.applicants a
  ORDER BY a.created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1000;
END;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.list_portal_users()
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_portal_users()
 RETURNS TABLE(username text, employee_nik text, display_name text, role text, has_stored_pin boolean, last_login timestamp with time zone, created_at timestamp with time zone, updated_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_portal_admin() THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Akses admin diperlukan.';
  END IF;
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT c.username,
         coalesce(nullif(c.employee_nik, ''), upper(c.username)),
         c.display_name,
         c.role,
         (c.pin_encrypted IS NOT NULL),
         c.last_login,
         c.created_at,
         c.updated_at
  FROM public.admin_login_credentials c
  ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.display_name ASC;
END;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.list_region_villages(p_district_id text, p_search text, p_limit integer)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_region_villages(p_district_id text, p_search text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 30)
 RETURNS TABLE(id text, name text, area_type text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select v.id, v.name, v.area_type from public.regions_villages v
  where v.district_id = p_district_id
    and (nullif(trim(p_search), '') is null
      or lower(v.name) like lower(left(trim(p_search), 60)) || '%')
  order by v.name
  limit greatest(1, least(coalesce(p_limit, 30), 30));
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.list_region_villages_with_postal_code(p_district_id text, p_search text, p_limit integer)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_region_villages_with_postal_code(p_district_id text, p_search text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 30)
 RETURNS TABLE(id text, name text, area_type text, postal_code text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select v.id, v.name, v.area_type, v.postal_code
  from public.regions_villages v
  where v.district_id = p_district_id
    and (
      nullif(trim(p_search), '') is null
      or lower(v.name) like lower(left(trim(p_search), 60)) || '%'
    )
  order by v.name
  limit greatest(1, least(coalesce(p_limit, 30), 30));
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.reveal_portal_user_pin(p_username text, p_password text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reveal_portal_user_pin(p_username text, p_password text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_encrypted text;
  v_secret text := 'hrga-workspace-pin-vault-v2-key';
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_portal_admin() OR NOT public.is_root_admin() THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Hanya akun Admin utama yang dapat melihat PIN user.';
  END IF;
  IF coalesce(p_password, '') <> '8karakterH!' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Password konfirmasi tidak sesuai.';
  END IF;
  SELECT pin_encrypted INTO v_encrypted
  FROM public.admin_login_credentials
  WHERE username = lower(btrim(coalesce(p_username, '')))
     OR lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(employee_nik, ''), '\s+', '', 'g')) = lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(p_username, ''), '\s+', '', 'g'))
  LIMIT 1;

  IF v_encrypted IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PIN user ini dibuat sebelum pembaruan. Silakan edit dan simpan ulang PIN.';
  END IF;
  RETURN extensions.pgp_sym_decrypt(decode(v_encrypted, 'base64'), v_secret);
END;
$function$


;

-- public.rls_auto_enable()
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rls_auto_enable()
 RETURNS event_trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  cmd record;
  tbl name;
BEGIN
  FOR cmd IN
    SELECT *
    FROM pg_event_trigger_ddl_commands()
    WHERE command_tag IN ('CREATE TABLE', 'CREATE TABLE AS', 'SELECT INTO')
      AND object_type IN ('table','partitioned table')
  LOOP
     IF cmd.schema_name IS NOT NULL AND cmd.schema_name IN ('public') AND cmd.schema_name NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema') AND cmd.schema_name NOT LIKE 'pg_toast%' AND cmd.schema_name NOT LIKE 'pg_temp%' THEN
      BEGIN
        SELECT c.relname INTO tbl FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c WHERE c.oid = cmd.objid;
        EXECUTE format('alter table if exists %I.%I enable row level security', cmd.schema_name, tbl);
        RAISE LOG 'rls_auto_enable: enabled RLS on %', cmd.object_identity;
      EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
          RAISE LOG 'rls_auto_enable: failed to enable RLS on %', cmd.object_identity;
      END;
     ELSE
        RAISE LOG 'rls_auto_enable: skip % (either system schema or not in enforced list: %.)', cmd.object_identity, cmd.schema_name;
     END IF;
  END LOOP;
END;
$function$


;

-- public.submit_candidate_application_public(p_data jsonb, p_cv_path text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.submit_candidate_application_public(p_data jsonb, p_cv_path text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_id uuid;
  v_name text;
  v_nik text;
  v_position text;
  v_ktp_path text;
  v_data jsonb := p_data;
  v_positions jsonb;
  v_index integer;
  v_start_month integer;
  v_start_year integer;
  v_end_month integer;
  v_end_year integer;
  v_duration integer;
  v_current boolean;
  v_months text[] := array[
    'Januari','Februari','Maret','April','Mei','Juni',
    'Juli','Agustus','September','Oktober','November','Desember'
  ];
begin
  if jsonb_typeof(p_data) <> 'object' then
    raise exception 'Data lamaran tidak valid.';
  end if;
  if octet_length(p_data::text) > 262144 then
    raise exception 'Ukuran data lamaran terlalu besar.';
  end if;

  v_name := nullif(btrim(p_data->>'nama'), '');
  v_nik := regexp_replace(coalesce(p_data->>'nik',''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g');
  v_position := nullif(btrim(p_data->>'posisi'), '');
  v_ktp_path := p_data->>'ktp_path';

  if v_name is null or char_length(v_name) < 2 or char_length(v_name) > 100 then
    raise exception 'Nama lengkap wajib diisi.';
  end if;
  if length(v_nik) <> 16 then
    raise exception 'NIK harus terdiri dari 16 angka.';
  end if;
  if v_position is null then
    raise exception 'Posisi yang dilamar wajib dipilih.';
  end if;

  select value into v_positions
  from public.portal_settings
  where key = 'application_positions';
  if jsonb_typeof(v_positions) = 'array'
     and not exists (
       select 1 from jsonb_array_elements_text(v_positions) p(value)
       where p.value = v_position
     ) then
    raise exception 'Posisi tidak tersedia. Muat ulang formulir dan pilih posisi dari daftar.';
  end if;

  if p_cv_path is null
     or p_cv_path !~ '^candidate-cv/[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}/cv[.]pdf$'
     or not exists (
       select 1 from storage.objects o
       where o.bucket_id = 'candidate-files' and o.name = p_cv_path
     ) then
    raise exception 'CV belum tersimpan atau lokasi file tidak valid.';
  end if;

  if v_ktp_path is null
     or v_ktp_path !~ '^candidate-identity/[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}/ktp[.]jpg$'
     or not exists (
       select 1 from storage.objects o
       where o.bucket_id = 'candidate-identity' and o.name = v_ktp_path
     ) then
    raise exception 'Foto KTP wajib diunggah dan tersimpan sebelum lamaran dikirim.';
  end if;

  if exists(select 1 from public.applicants a where a.nik = v_nik) then
    raise exception 'NIK ini sudah terdaftar. Periksa kembali data atau hubungi tim HR.';
  end if;

  for v_index in 1..3 loop
    v_start_month := array_position(v_months, v_data->>('kerja' || v_index || '_mulai_bulan'));
    v_start_year := nullif(v_data->>('kerja' || v_index || '_mulai_tahun'), '')::integer;
    v_current := lower(coalesce(v_data->>('kerja' || v_index || '_masih_bekerja'),'false')) in ('true','1','yes');

    if v_current then
      v_end_month := extract(month from current_date)::integer;
      v_end_year := extract(year from current_date)::integer;
      v_data := jsonb_set(v_data, array['kerja' || v_index || '_selesai_bulan'], to_jsonb(v_months[v_end_month]), true);
      v_data := jsonb_set(v_data, array['kerja' || v_index || '_selesai_tahun'], to_jsonb(v_end_year::text), true);
    else
      v_end_month := array_position(v_months, v_data->>('kerja' || v_index || '_selesai_bulan'));
      v_end_year := nullif(v_data->>('kerja' || v_index || '_selesai_tahun'), '')::integer;
    end if;

    if v_start_month is not null and v_start_year is not null
       and v_end_month is not null and v_end_year is not null then
      v_duration := (v_end_year - v_start_year) * 12 + (v_end_month - v_start_month) + 1;
      if v_duration < 1 then
        raise exception 'Periode pengalaman kerja ke-% harus berakhir setelah tanggal mulai.', v_index;
      end if;
      v_data := jsonb_set(v_data, array['kerja' || v_index || '_durasi'], to_jsonb(v_duration), true);
    end if;
  end loop;

  insert into public.applicants(
    full_name, nik, position, stage, application_data, cv_path, ktp_path
  )
  values (
    v_name, v_nik, v_position,
    'application_submitted', v_data, p_cv_path, v_ktp_path
  )
  returning id into v_id;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'application_id', v_id,
    'full_name', v_name,
    'stage', 'application_submitted'
  );
exception
  when unique_violation then
    raise exception 'NIK ini sudah terdaftar. Periksa kembali data atau hubungi tim HR.';
end;
$function$


;

-- public.submit_disc_answers_by_nik(p_nik text, p_answers jsonb)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.submit_disc_answers_by_nik(p_nik text, p_answers jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_nik text := regexp_replace(coalesce(p_nik, ''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g');
  v_applicant_id uuid;
  v_answer jsonb;
  v_most integer;
  v_least integer;
BEGIN
  IF length(v_nik) <> 16 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'NIK harus terdiri dari 16 angka.';
  END IF;
  IF jsonb_typeof(p_answers) <> 'array' OR jsonb_array_length(p_answers) <> 24 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Tes DISC harus berisi 24 jawaban.';
  END IF;
  SELECT a.id INTO v_applicant_id
  FROM public.applicants a
  WHERE a.nik = v_nik
    AND a.stage = 'application_submitted'
  ORDER BY a.created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1;
  IF v_applicant_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'NIK tidak ditemukan atau lamaran Tahap 2 belum terdaftar.';
  END IF;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.disc_submissions d WHERE d.applicant_id = v_applicant_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Tes DISC sudah pernah diselesaikan.';
  END IF;
  FOR v_answer IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_answers) LOOP
    IF jsonb_typeof(v_answer) <> 'object' THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Format jawaban DISC tidak valid.';
    END IF;
    v_most := nullif(v_answer->>'most', '')::integer;
    v_least := nullif(v_answer->>'least', '')::integer;
    IF v_most IS NULL OR v_least IS NULL
       OR v_most NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 3
       OR v_least NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 3
       OR v_most = v_least THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Pilih tepat satu P dan satu K pada setiap nomor.';
    END IF;
  END LOOP;
  INSERT INTO public.disc_submissions(applicant_id, answers)
  VALUES(v_applicant_id, p_answers);
  UPDATE public.applicants
  SET stage = 'disc_completed', updated_at = now()
  WHERE id = v_applicant_id;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'stage', 'disc_completed');
END;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.upsert_portal_user(p_nik text, p_full_name text, p_role text, p_pin text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.upsert_portal_user(p_nik text, p_full_name text, p_role text DEFAULT 'Superadmin'::text, p_pin text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_display_nik text := upper(btrim(regexp_replace(coalesce(p_nik, ''), '\s+', ' ', 'g')));
  v_username text := lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(p_nik, ''), '[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]', '', 'g'));
  v_name text := btrim(coalesce(p_full_name, ''));
  v_role text := CASE WHEN btrim(coalesce(p_role, '')) IN ('Superadmin', 'admin', 'hr') THEN btrim(p_role) ELSE 'Superadmin' END;
  v_pin text := nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_pin, '')), '');
  v_exists boolean;
  v_auth_user_id uuid;
  v_secret text := 'hrga-workspace-pin-vault-v2-key';
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_portal_admin() OR NOT public.is_root_admin() THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Hanya akun Admin utama yang dapat menambahkan atau mengubah user.';
  END IF;
  IF length(v_username) < 3 OR length(v_username) > 32 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'NIK Karyawan minimal 3 karakter alfanumerik dan maksimal 32 karakter.';
  END IF;
  IF length(v_name) < 2 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Nama karyawan wajib diisi.';
  END IF;

  SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.admin_login_credentials WHERE username = v_username),
         (SELECT auth_user_id FROM public.admin_login_credentials WHERE username = v_username)
  INTO v_exists, v_auth_user_id;

  IF NOT v_exists AND (v_pin IS NULL OR v_pin !~ '^\d{4,12}$') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PIN wajib diisi 4–12 digit angka untuk user baru.';
  END IF;
  IF v_pin IS NOT NULL AND v_pin !~ '^\d{4,12}$' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PIN harus terdiri dari 4–12 digit angka.';
  END IF;

  IF v_exists THEN
    UPDATE public.admin_login_credentials
    SET employee_nik = v_display_nik,
        display_name = v_name,
        role = v_role,
        pin_hash = CASE WHEN v_pin IS NOT NULL THEN extensions.crypt(v_pin, extensions.gen_salt('bf')) ELSE pin_hash END,
        pin_encrypted = CASE WHEN v_pin IS NOT NULL THEN encode(extensions.pgp_sym_encrypt(v_pin, v_secret), 'base64') ELSE pin_encrypted END,
        failed_attempts = 0,
        locked_until = null,
        updated_at = now()
    WHERE username = v_username;

    IF v_auth_user_id IS NOT NULL THEN
      UPDATE public.admin_users
      SET display_name = v_name,
          role = v_role
      WHERE user_id = v_auth_user_id;
    END IF;
  ELSE
    INSERT INTO public.admin_login_credentials (
      username, employee_nik, display_name, role, pin_hash, pin_encrypted
    ) VALUES (
      v_username,
      v_display_nik,
      v_name,
      v_role,
      extensions.crypt(v_pin, extensions.gen_salt('bf')),
      encode(extensions.pgp_sym_encrypt(v_pin, v_secret), 'base64')
    );
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'username', v_username,
    'employee_nik', v_display_nik,
    'display_name', v_name,
    'role', v_role
  );
END;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.verify_admin_pin(p_username text, p_pin text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.verify_admin_pin(p_username text, p_pin text)
 RETURNS TABLE(ok boolean, auth_user_id uuid, display_name text, role text, message text, attempts_left integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_credential public.admin_login_credentials%rowtype;
  v_attempts integer;
  v_raw text := lower(btrim(coalesce(p_username, '')));
  v_norm text := lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(p_username, ''), '\s+', '', 'g'));
  v_pin text := coalesce(p_pin, '');
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO v_credential
  FROM public.admin_login_credentials
  WHERE lower(username) = v_raw
     OR lower(username) = v_norm
     OR lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(employee_nik, ''), '\s+', '', 'g')) = v_norm
  ORDER BY (lower(username) = v_raw) DESC
  LIMIT 1
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN QUERY SELECT false, null::uuid, null::text, null::text,
      'NIK Karyawan atau PIN tidak sesuai.', 0;
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  IF v_credential.locked_until IS NOT NULL AND v_credential.locked_until > now() THEN
    RETURN QUERY SELECT false, null::uuid, null::text, null::text,
      'Login dikunci sementara. Silakan coba lagi setelah 15 menit.', 0;
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  IF extensions.crypt(v_pin, v_credential.pin_hash) = v_credential.pin_hash THEN
    UPDATE public.admin_login_credentials
    SET failed_attempts = 0,
        locked_until = null,
        last_login = now(),
        updated_at = now()
    WHERE username = v_credential.username;

    RETURN QUERY SELECT true, v_credential.auth_user_id,
      v_credential.display_name, v_credential.role, 'OK', 5;
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  v_attempts := v_credential.failed_attempts + 1;
  UPDATE public.admin_login_credentials
  SET failed_attempts = v_attempts,
      locked_until = CASE WHEN v_attempts >= 5 THEN now() + interval '15 minutes' ELSE null END,
      updated_at = now()
  WHERE username = v_credential.username;

  RETURN QUERY SELECT false, null::uuid, null::text, null::text,
    CASE WHEN v_attempts >= 5
      THEN 'Terlalu banyak percobaan. Login dikunci selama 15 menit.'
      ELSE 'NIK Karyawan atau PIN tidak sesuai.'
    END,
    greatest(0, 5 - v_attempts);
END;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- realtime.apply_rls(wal jsonb, max_record_bytes integer)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION realtime.apply_rls(wal jsonb, max_record_bytes integer DEFAULT (1024 * 1024))
 RETURNS SETOF realtime.wal_rls
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
declare
    -- Regclass of the table e.g. public.notes
    entity_ regclass = (quote_ident(wal ->> 'schema') || '.' || quote_ident(wal ->> 'table'))::regclass;

    -- I, U, D, T: insert, update ...
    action realtime.action = (
        case wal ->> 'action'
            when 'I' then 'INSERT'
            when 'U' then 'UPDATE'
            when 'D' then 'DELETE'
            else 'ERROR'
        end
    );

    -- Is row level security enabled for the table
    is_rls_enabled bool = relrowsecurity from pg_class where oid = entity_;

    subscriptions realtime.subscription[] = array_agg(subs)
        from
            realtime.subscription subs
        where
            subs.entity = entity_
            -- Filter by action early - only get subscriptions interested in this action
            -- action_filter column can be: '*' (all), 'INSERT', 'UPDATE', or 'DELETE'
            and (subs.action_filter = '*' or subs.action_filter = action::text);

    -- Subscription vars
    working_role regrole;
    working_selected_columns text[];
    claimed_role regrole;
    claims jsonb;

    subscription_id uuid;
    subscription_has_access bool;
    visible_to_subscription_ids uuid[] = '{}';

    -- structured info for wal's columns
    columns realtime.wal_column[];
    -- previous identity values for update/delete
    old_columns realtime.wal_column[];

    -- the same values as wal2json sent them, which is what filters compare against
    raw_columns realtime.wal_column[] =
        array_agg((x->>'name', x->>'type', x->>'typeoid', x->'value', null, null)::realtime.wal_column)
        from jsonb_array_elements(wal -> 'columns') x;
    raw_old_columns realtime.wal_column[] =
        array_agg((x->>'name', x->>'type', x->>'typeoid', x->'value', null, null)::realtime.wal_column)
        from jsonb_array_elements(wal -> 'identity') x;

    error_record_exceeds_max_size boolean = octet_length(wal::text) > max_record_bytes;

    -- Primary jsonb output for record
    output jsonb;

    -- Loop record for iterating unique roles (outer loop)
    role_record record;
    -- Loop record for iterating unique selected_columns within a role (inner loop)
    cols_record record;
    -- Subscription ids visible at the role level (before fanning out by selected_columns)
    visible_role_sub_ids uuid[] = '{}';

begin
    perform set_config('role', null, true);

    columns =
        array_agg(
            (
                x->>'name',
                x->>'type',
                x->>'typeoid',
                realtime.cast(
                    (x->'value') #>> '{}',
                    coalesce(
                        (x->>'typeoid')::regtype, -- null when wal2json version <= 2.4
                        (x->>'type')::regtype
                    )
                ),
                (pks ->> 'name') is not null,
                true
            )::realtime.wal_column
        )
        from
            jsonb_array_elements(wal -> 'columns') x
            left join jsonb_array_elements(wal -> 'pk') pks
                on (x ->> 'name') = (pks ->> 'name');

    old_columns =
        array_agg(
            (
                x->>'name',
                x->>'type',
                x->>'typeoid',
                realtime.cast(
                    (x->'value') #>> '{}',
                    coalesce(
                        (x->>'typeoid')::regtype, -- null when wal2json version <= 2.4
                        (x->>'type')::regtype
                    )
                ),
                (pks ->> 'name') is not null,
                true
            )::realtime.wal_column
        )
        from
            jsonb_array_elements(wal -> 'identity') x
            left join jsonb_array_elements(wal -> 'pk') pks
                on (x ->> 'name') = (pks ->> 'name');

    for role_record in
        select claims_role
        from (select distinct claims_role from unnest(subscriptions)) t
        order by claims_role::text
    loop
        working_role := role_record.claims_role;

        -- Update `is_selectable` for columns and old_columns (once per role)
        columns =
            array_agg(
                (
                    c.name,
                    c.type_name,
                    c.type_oid,
                    c.value,
                    c.is_pkey,
                    pg_catalog.has_column_privilege(working_role, entity_, c.name, 'SELECT')
                )::realtime.wal_column
            )
            from
                unnest(columns) c;

        old_columns =
                array_agg(
                    (
                        c.name,
                        c.type_name,
                        c.type_oid,
                        c.value,
                        c.is_pkey,
                        pg_catalog.has_column_privilege(working_role, entity_, c.name, 'SELECT')
                    )::realtime.wal_column
                )
                from
                    unnest(old_columns) c;

        if action <> 'DELETE' and count(1) = 0 from unnest(columns) c where c.is_pkey then
            -- Fan out 400 error per distinct selected_columns for this role
            for cols_record in
                select selected_columns
                from (select distinct selected_columns from unnest(subscriptions) s where s.claims_role = working_role) t
                order by coalesce(array_to_string(selected_columns, ','), '')
            loop
                working_selected_columns := cols_record.selected_columns;
                return next (
                    jsonb_build_object(
                        'schema', wal ->> 'schema',
                        'table', wal ->> 'table',
                        'type', action
                    ),
                    is_rls_enabled,
                    (select array_agg(s.subscription_id) from unnest(subscriptions) as s where s.claims_role = working_role and (s.selected_columns is not distinct from working_selected_columns)),
                    array['Error 400: Bad Request, no primary key']
                )::realtime.wal_rls;
            end loop;

        -- The claims role does not have SELECT permission to the primary key of entity
        elsif action <> 'DELETE' and sum(c.is_selectable::int) <> count(1) from unnest(columns) c where c.is_pkey then
            -- Fan out 401 error per distinct selected_columns for this role
            for cols_record in
                select selected_columns
                from (select distinct selected_columns from unnest(subscriptions) s where s.claims_role = working_role) t
                order by coalesce(array_to_string(selected_columns, ','), '')
            loop
                working_selected_columns := cols_record.selected_columns;
                return next (
                    jsonb_build_object(
                        'schema', wal ->> 'schema',
                        'table', wal ->> 'table',
                        'type', action
                    ),
                    is_rls_enabled,
                    (select array_agg(s.subscription_id) from unnest(subscriptions) as s where s.claims_role = working_role and (s.selected_columns is not distinct from working_selected_columns)),
                    array['Error 401: Unauthorized']
                )::realtime.wal_rls;
            end loop;

        else
            -- Create the prepared statement (once per role)
            if is_rls_enabled and action <> 'DELETE' then
                if (select 1 from pg_prepared_statements where name = 'walrus_rls_stmt' limit 1) > 0 then
                    deallocate walrus_rls_stmt;
                end if;
                execute realtime.build_prepared_statement_sql('walrus_rls_stmt', entity_, columns);
            end if;

            -- Collect all visible subscription IDs for this role (filter check + RLS check)
            visible_role_sub_ids = '{}';

            for subscription_id, claims in (
                    select
                        subs.subscription_id,
                        subs.claims
                    from
                        unnest(subscriptions) subs
                    where
                        subs.entity = entity_
                        and subs.claims_role = working_role
                        and (
                            realtime.is_visible_through_filters(raw_columns, subs.filters)
                            or (
                              action = 'DELETE'
                              and realtime.is_visible_through_filters(raw_old_columns, subs.filters)
                            )
                        )
            ) loop

                if not is_rls_enabled or action = 'DELETE' then
                    visible_role_sub_ids = visible_role_sub_ids || subscription_id;
                else
                    -- Check if RLS allows the role to see the record
                    perform
                        -- Trim leading and trailing quotes from working_role because set_config
                        -- doesn't recognize the role as valid if they are included
                        set_config('role', trim(both '"' from working_role::text), true),
                        set_config('request.jwt.claims', claims::text, true);

                    execute 'execute walrus_rls_stmt' into subscription_has_access;

                    -- Reset the role on every FOR..LOOP batch execution.
                    -- The first batch of 10 rows is pre-fetched using the current connection role (PG internal behaviour)
                    -- then we have to reset it again otherwise it would use the role defined in the `set_config` above
                    -- to fetch the remaining rows when rows>10, which could be a user-defined role that lacks execution grants.
                    -- The flow is:
                    --   1. run batch with conn role
                    --   2. set_config working_role
                    --   3. execute walrus
                    --   4. reset role (revert)
                    --   5. repeat
                    perform set_config('role', null, true);

                    if subscription_has_access then
                        visible_role_sub_ids = visible_role_sub_ids || subscription_id;
                    end if;
                end if;
            end loop;

            perform set_config('role', null, true);

            -- Inner loop: per distinct selected_columns for this role
            for cols_record in
                select selected_columns
                from (select distinct selected_columns from unnest(subscriptions) s where s.claims_role = working_role) t
                order by coalesce(array_to_string(selected_columns, ','), '')
            loop
                working_selected_columns := cols_record.selected_columns;

                output = jsonb_build_object(
                    'schema', wal ->> 'schema',
                    'table', wal ->> 'table',
                    'type', action,
                    'commit_timestamp', to_char(
                        ((wal ->> 'timestamp')::timestamptz at time zone 'utc'),
                        'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"'
                    ),
                    'columns', (
                        select
                            jsonb_agg(
                                jsonb_build_object(
                                    'name', pa.attname,
                                    'type', pt.typname
                                )
                                order by pa.attnum asc
                            )
                        from
                            pg_attribute pa
                            join pg_type pt
                                on pa.atttypid = pt.oid
                            left join (
                                select unnest(conkey) as pkey_attnum
                                from pg_constraint
                                where conrelid = entity_ and contype = 'p'
                            ) pk on pk.pkey_attnum = pa.attnum
                        where
                            attrelid = entity_
                            and attnum > 0
                            and pg_catalog.has_column_privilege(working_role, entity_, pa.attname, 'SELECT')
                            and (working_selected_columns is null or pa.attname = any(working_selected_columns) or pk.pkey_attnum is not null)
                    )
                )
                -- Add "record" key for insert and update
                || case
                    when action in ('INSERT', 'UPDATE') then
                        jsonb_build_object(
                            'record',
                            (
                                select
                                    jsonb_object_agg(
                                        -- if unchanged toast, get column name and value from old record
                                        coalesce((c).name, (oc).name),
                                        case
                                            when (c).name is null then (oc).value
                                            else (c).value
                                        end
                                    )
                                from
                                    unnest(columns) c
                                    full outer join unnest(old_columns) oc
                                        on (c).name = (oc).name
                                where
                                    coalesce((c).is_selectable, (oc).is_selectable)
                                    and (working_selected_columns is null or coalesce((c).name, (oc).name) = any(working_selected_columns) or coalesce((c).is_pkey, (oc).is_pkey))
                                    and ( not error_record_exceeds_max_size or (octet_length((c).value::text) <= 64))
                            )
                        )
                    else '{}'::jsonb
                end
                -- Add "old_record" key for update and delete
                || case
                    when action = 'UPDATE' then
                        jsonb_build_object(
                                'old_record',
                                (
                                    select jsonb_object_agg((c).name, (c).value)
                                    from unnest(old_columns) c
                                    where
                                        (c).is_selectable
                                        and (working_selected_columns is null or (c).name = any(working_selected_columns) or (c).is_pkey)
                                        and ( not error_record_exceeds_max_size or (octet_length((c).value::text) <= 64))
                                )
                            )
                    when action = 'DELETE' then
                        jsonb_build_object(
                            'old_record',
                            (
                                select jsonb_object_agg((c).name, (c).value)
                                from unnest(old_columns) c
                                where
                                    (c).is_selectable
                                    and (working_selected_columns is null or (c).name = any(working_selected_columns) or (c).is_pkey)
                                    and ( not error_record_exceeds_max_size or (octet_length((c).value::text) <= 64))
                                    and ( not is_rls_enabled or (c).is_pkey ) -- if RLS enabled, we can't secure deletes so filter to pkey
                            )
                        )
                    else '{}'::jsonb
                end;

                -- Filter visible_role_sub_ids to those matching the current selected_columns group
                visible_to_subscription_ids = coalesce(
                    (
                        select array_agg(s.subscription_id)
                        from unnest(subscriptions) s
                        where s.claims_role = working_role
                          and (s.selected_columns is not distinct from working_selected_columns)
                          and s.subscription_id = any(visible_role_sub_ids)
                    ),
                    '{}'::uuid[]
                );

                return next (
                    output,
                    is_rls_enabled,
                    visible_to_subscription_ids,
                    case
                        when error_record_exceeds_max_size then array['Error 413: Payload Too Large']
                        else '{}'
                    end
                )::realtime.wal_rls;
            end loop;

        end if;
    end loop;

    perform set_config('role', null, true);
end;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- realtime.authorize(role_name text, topic_name text, claims text, sub text, headers text, read_extensions text[], write_extensions text[], OUT read_allowed boolean[], OUT write_allowed boolean[])
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION realtime.authorize(role_name text, topic_name text, claims text, sub text, headers text, read_extensions text[], write_extensions text[], OUT read_allowed boolean[], OUT write_allowed boolean[])
 RETURNS record
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
declare
  probe_ids uuid[];
  probe_inserted_at timestamp := now() at time zone 'utc';
  visible_ids uuid[];
  ext text;
  allowed boolean;
begin
  -- The probe inserts are rolled back, but they still give the transaction an xid, so it ends
  -- in a commit. Nothing durable was written, so skip waiting on the WAL flush and sync standbys.
  -- Set outside the block below, whose rollback would undo it.
  perform set_config('synchronous_commit', 'off', true);

  -- The RAISE at the end of this block rolls back everything in it.
  begin
    probe_ids := array(select gen_random_uuid() from unnest(read_extensions));

    insert into realtime.messages (id, topic, extension, inserted_at, updated_at)
    select p.id, topic_name, p.extension, probe_inserted_at, probe_inserted_at
    from unnest(probe_ids, read_extensions) as p(id, extension);

    perform set_config('role', role_name, true),
            set_config('realtime.topic', topic_name, true),
            set_config('request.jwt.claims', claims, true),
            set_config('request.jwt.claim.sub', sub, true),
            set_config('request.jwt.claim.role', role_name, true),
            set_config('request.headers', headers, true);

    -- One lookup for every probe, by the full primary key. Skipped without probes, so the
    -- SELECT policies are not planned for a write.
    if cardinality(probe_ids) > 0 then
      visible_ids := array(
        select m.id
        from realtime.messages m
        where m.inserted_at = probe_inserted_at
          and m.id = any(probe_ids));
    end if;

    read_allowed := array(
      select p.id = any(visible_ids)
      from unnest(probe_ids) with ordinality as p(id, n)
      order by p.n);

    write_allowed := '{}';

    foreach ext in array write_extensions loop
      begin
        insert into realtime.messages (topic, extension, inserted_at, updated_at)
        values (topic_name, ext, now() at time zone 'utc', now() at time zone 'utc');

        allowed := true;
      exception when insufficient_privilege then
        allowed := false;
      end;

      write_allowed := write_allowed || allowed;
    end loop;

    raise sqlstate 'RTA01';
  exception when sqlstate 'RTA01' then
    null;
  end;
end;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- realtime.broadcast_changes(topic_name text, event_name text, operation text, table_name text, table_schema text, new record, old record, level text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION realtime.broadcast_changes(topic_name text, event_name text, operation text, table_name text, table_schema text, new record, old record, level text DEFAULT 'ROW'::text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
    -- Declare a variable to hold the JSONB representation of the row
    row_data jsonb := '{}'::jsonb;
BEGIN
    IF level = 'STATEMENT' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'function can only be triggered for each row, not for each statement';
    END IF;
    -- Check the operation type and handle accordingly
    IF operation = 'INSERT' OR operation = 'UPDATE' OR operation = 'DELETE' THEN
        row_data := jsonb_build_object('old_record', OLD, 'record', NEW, 'operation', operation, 'table', table_name, 'schema', table_schema);
        PERFORM realtime.send (row_data, event_name, topic_name);
    ELSE
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unexpected operation type: %', operation;
    END IF;
EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Failed to process the row: %', SQLERRM;
END;

$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- realtime.build_prepared_statement_sql(prepared_statement_name text, entity regclass, columns realtime.wal_column[])
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION realtime.build_prepared_statement_sql(prepared_statement_name text, entity regclass, columns realtime.wal_column[])
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
AS $function$
      /*
      Builds a sql string that, if executed, creates a prepared statement to
      tests retrive a row from *entity* by its primary key columns.
      Example
          select realtime.build_prepared_statement_sql('public.notes', '{"id"}'::text[], '{"bigint"}'::text[])
      */
          select
      'prepare ' || prepared_statement_name || ' as
          select
              exists(
                  select
                      1
                  from
                      ' || entity || '
                  where
                      ' || string_agg(quote_ident(pkc.name) || '=' || quote_nullable(pkc.value #>> '{}') , ' and ') || '
              )'
          from
              unnest(columns) pkc
          where
              pkc.is_pkey
          group by
              entity
      $function$


;
